findings.title: Restore per-rule pause and delete actions in the new list
findings.body: Grafana list rows now pass only promRule to RuleActionsButtons, but AlertRuleMenu still renders pause/unpause only when rulerRule is a Grafana rule and Delete only when rulerRule exists. Consequently, both actions disappear from every Grafana row in the grouped and filtered lists, even when the newly calculated permissions allow them. Adapt these actions to use the rule identifier/Prometheus DTO or load the definition on demand.

findings.title: Make Silence notifications work for Prometheus-only rows
findings.body: The new Grafana list rows have promRule but no ruler rule. Their menu can now display Silence notifications using Prometheus abilities, but clicking it only sets showSilenceDrawer; this condition still requires rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule), which is false when rule is undefined. The visible action therefore does nothing. Fetch the definition when invoked or adapt the drawer to accept the identifier/Prometheus rule.

findings.title: Return neutral abilities when skipToken is supplied
findings.body: skipToken is converted to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) treats Duplicate as supported and allows it whenever the user has Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu supplies skipToken for non-Grafana rules and ORs this result with the ruler abilities. A user who can create Grafana rules is therefore offered Duplicate on external rules even when external-write permission is denied or the external ruler is unavailable. Skipped input must not contribute an affirmative ability.

findings.title: Preserve federated-group immutability for CombinedRule consumers
findings.body: Delegating useAllAlertRuleAbilities to useAllRulerRuleAbilities drops the previous isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) check, and the delegated implementation hardcodes isFederated to false. For Mimir groups with source_tenants and an enabled ruler, existing CombinedRule consumers now report Update/Delete as supported for users with external-write permission, whereas these federated groups were previously explicitly immutable. Preserve the group-level restriction when adapting the CombinedRule hook.

findings.title: Keep export available for Grafana-managed recording rules
findings.body: ModifyExport support is now based on isAlertingRule, which is false for GrafanaPromRecordingRuleDTO. Both Grafana list paths now supply only the Prometheus DTO, so there is no ruler-based ability to enable the Export menu as a fallback. Grafana-managed recording rules therefore lose their previously available export action even for users with read permission. Export support should recognize both Grafana alerting and recording rules.

findings.title: Preserve the return location in rule-view links
findings.body: The previous Grafana list item included createReturnTo() in this link, but the replacement omits the returnTo parameter entirely. Opening a rule from a filtered list no longer passes the current list URL to the viewer's return navigation, so returning to the list loses the user's filters/view state. Keep the current return location when constructing the new link.
